nodes.label: Integrated terminal (managed PTY sessions)
nodes.rationale: Rust chooses shell/args/cwd; no process-launch IPC; Unix child fchdir to authorized handle; bounded buffers with backpressure; Job Object on Windows.

nodes.label: Package responsibilities (shell, editor, explorer, search, state, src-tauri, contracts, design-system)
nodes.norm_label: package responsibilities (shell, editor, explorer, search, state, src-tauri, contracts, design-system)

nodes.label: Versioned atomic saves and conflict handling
nodes.norm_label: versioned atomic saves and conflict handling
nodes.rationale: Staged same-directory replacement with identity revalidation; atomic swap on Unix, recovery-rename + hard link on Windows; drafts preserved on conflict.

nodes.label: Workbench layout and versioned layout preferences
nodes.norm_label: workbench layout and versioned layout preferences

nodes.label: Workspace authorization (caller-bound registration, handle-relative access)
nodes.rationale: Rust canonicalizes picker selection, retains directory handle, rejects traversal/absolute/symlinks; operations check Tauri caller plus active registration.

nodes.label: Workspace search (bounded literal scan with cancellation)
nodes.norm_label: workspace search (bounded literal scan with cancellation)
nodes.rationale: Releases registry lock before scanning and rechecks authorization before returning; fixed skip list and limits (500 matches, 50k entries, 128 MiB, 10 s).

nodes.label: Nebula v2 acceptance criteria (visual, a11y, layout, file workflows, quality)
nodes.norm_label: nebula v2 acceptance criteria (visual, a11y, layout, file workflows, quality)

nodes.norm_label: command palette and shared command descriptors

nodes.label: Nebula v2 design tokens (surfaces, accent violet, signal cyan)
nodes.norm_label: nebula v2 design tokens (surfaces, accent violet, signal cyan)
nodes.rationale: Violet edge marks active destination; cyan reserved for live editor info. System fonts limit startup cost and give native text rendering.

nodes.label: Terminal Noir visual reference
nodes.rationale: Adapt slim rail, tab strip, tree, dock tabs, status layout; exclude its branding, simulated Git/diagnostics/AI and sample files.

nodes.label: Workbench composition (header, rail, Explorer, editor, dock, AI panel, status bar)
nodes.norm_label: workbench composition (header, rail, explorer, editor, dock, ai panel, status bar)

nodes.label: CI no-bundle native build on Linux/macOS/Windows
nodes.norm_label: ci no-bundle native build on linux/macos/windows

nodes.label: Native security rules (default-deny, Rust-owned authorization)
nodes.rationale: Frontend-supplied paths or workspace IDs are not proof of access; operations bind to verified caller and active approved workspace; paths validated at operation time against traversal, symlink escape, and root-replacement races.

nodes.label: Quality gates (lint, format, typecheck, tests, build, cargo fmt)
nodes.norm_label: quality gates (lint, format, typecheck, tests, build, cargo fmt)
nodes.rationale: A green compile job is not evidence of GUI launch; report untested platforms explicitly and never claim tests passed without running them.

nodes.label: Scope and Git discipline
nodes.rationale: Implement only the requested work package; no commits, pushes, or releases without explicit user approval.

nodes.label: UI/UX Design Authority
nodes.rationale: Approved redesigns may restructure presentation code substantially, but must preserve functionality, regression coverage, honest controls, and all security/architecture/quality rules.

nodes.label: Splitter and responsive layout rules
nodes.rationale: 6 px splitter hit area with keyboard resizing; side panes shrink before editor; overlays below 920 px; new profiles start with dock and AI closed.

nodes.label: React component boundaries for Workbench
nodes.rationale: Lazy-load Monaco, narrow Zustand slices, persist only versioned validated dimensions/visibility with no document content or native handles.

nodes.label: Nebula Icon Palette (lavender violet on near-black navy)
nodes.norm_label: nebula icon palette (lavender violet on near-black navy)

nodes.label: Orbit Motif (tilted elliptical ring, central core, orbiting satellite)
nodes.norm_label: orbit motif (tilted elliptical ring, central core, orbiting satellite)

nodes.label: Graphify (code-graph engine candidate)
nodes.rationale: Evaluated through a replaceable interface, not a mandatory dependency, to avoid lock-in and unvalidated suitability.

nodes.label: Recovery Journal
nodes.rationale: Never discard recovery data until reconciled; never overwrite newer disk content during restoration.

nodes.label: Performance and Hardware Targets
nodes.rationale: Provisional engineering targets (warm startup <=3s, typing P95 <=50ms, idle <=500MB), not validated measurements.

nodes.label: Adaptive Intelligence (Token Efficiency)
nodes.rationale: Token-conservative does not mean stingy: use every token necessary for correctness, waste none unnecessarily.

nodes.label: Extensions and Integrations (native, MCP, VS Code compat)
nodes.norm_label: extensions and integrations (native, mcp, vs code compat)

nodes.label: Open-Core Editions (Community/Pro/Teams/Enterprise)
nodes.rationale: Community must remain genuinely useful without subscription; Apache 2.0 recommended but not finalized.

nodes.label: Native Permission Gateway
nodes.rationale: Native core mediates privileged filesystem, terminal and Git actions so permissions are enforced independently of model instructions.

nodes.label: Incremental Release Roadmap (v0.1-v1.0)
nodes.rationale: Release gates and staged delivery mitigate scope creep.

nodes.label: Supervised Agent Mode
nodes.rationale: Supervised autonomy with approvals, diffs, checkpoints and rollback mitigates agent overreach, prompt injection and faulty AI edits.

nodes.label: Turing Evolution (Self-Learning)
nodes.rationale: Local-first learning; shared contributions require explicit opt-in; prevent uncontrolled self-modification.

nodes.label: Turing AI-Native IDE
nodes.rationale: A complete professional IDE with AI deeply integrated, not a chatbot attached to an editor; must stay useful without a cloud AI subscription.

nodes.label: Turing Nebula Design System
nodes.rationale: Dark-first futuristic direction: midnight backgrounds, violet/cyan accents, restrained glass panels; visual concept is a reference, not a rigid blueprint; effects must not impair performance or readability.

nodes.label: Frontend Architecture (WorkspaceShell, Zustand stores)
nodes.rationale: Monaco models managed separately from serialized UI state; UI never directly executes OS commands or accesses arbitrary paths.

nodes.label: Model Provider Abstraction (listModels/generate/cancel)
nodes.rationale: Explicit user choice and privacy override adaptive routing; token efficiency cannot override correctness or hard budgets.

nodes.label: Rust Native Core
nodes.rationale: Validates canonicalized resources; never treats caller-provided workspace IDs as sufficient authorization; centralized permission engine.

nodes.label: Python AI Runtime (FastAPI)
nodes.rationale: Separately managed service over authenticated local channel so AI failure cannot stop the IDE.

nodes.label: Security Architecture (approval tiers)
nodes.rationale: No model may grant itself privileges; repository instructions and tool output are untrusted.

nodes.label: Developer Tools Requirements (Terminal, Git, DAP, Tests)
nodes.norm_label: developer tools requirements (terminal, git, dap, tests)

nodes.label: Provider-Independent Model Routing (MODEL-001-006)
nodes.rationale: Never silently transmit local source to cloud inference; credentials never stored as plaintext workspace settings.

nodes.label: Editor File Lifecycle (open/save with version conflict)
nodes.norm_label: editor file lifecycle (open/save with version conflict)
nodes.rationale: Clear dirty flag only on confirmed save; reject conflicts on expectedVersion mismatch to prevent silent overwrites.

nodes.label: EditorTab / EditorState
nodes.rationale: Stores hold UI metadata, not live Monaco model objects.

nodes.label: Git CLI Adapter
nodes.rationale: Structured argument arrays, never shell-string concatenation.

nodes.label: Native Command API (workspace_open, fs_*)
nodes.rationale: All paths checked against trusted workspace registration and canonical targets including symlinks; stable error codes NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, OUTSIDE_WORKSPACE, FILE_CONFLICT, INVALID_ENCODING, IO_ERROR.

nodes.label: PTY Terminal (xterm.js + portable-pty)
nodes.rationale: User terminal privileges are distinct from later agent command permissions.

nodes.label: Tests and CI (Vitest, Cargo, E2E, GitHub Actions)
nodes.norm_label: tests and ci (vitest, cargo, e2e, github actions)

nodes.label: Trusted Workspace Registry and Resource Operations
nodes.norm_label: trusted workspace registry and resource operations
nodes.rationale: Frontend workspace IDs cannot grant permissions; validate canonical targets at operation time.

nodes.label: Architecture Principles (IDE-first, local-first, modular)
nodes.rationale: Editing, Git, terminal and debugging must not require AI; providers, indexes and extensions must be replaceable.
